text:
arya: Quick recap from the A/B against v3.9-prod -> v4-lite-q: generation quality basically flat on MRR but cost/token up ~12% and tail latency higher for longdocs. want to avoid promoting purely on MRR anymore. thoughts on multi-metric gate?
owen: Agreed. propose a composite_score = w_m * mrr_norm - w_p * p95_norm - w_c * cost_norm. we normalize each metric to baseline.
tony: normalization detail matters. use rank-transform for mrr (to reduce outlier influence) and log-scale for cost. also add a deadband so tiny noise doesn't flip a decision.
leah: safety hooks: staged traffic only, and two auto-rollback checks: (1) hallucination_rate > 1.5x baseline sustained 10m, (2) cost_per_token > 1.2x baseline for 15m. plus manual override.
rollout-bot: /ab-report run --exp=v4-lite-q --slice=longdocs --dur=2h -> mrr: +0.3% (p=0.12), p95: +22ms, cost_per_token: +12%, halluc: +0.6%
owen: looks marginal. if we weight cost heavily we'll reject. recommendation: w_m=0.6, w_p=0.25, w_c=0.15, consensus_threshold=0.015 with deadband=0.005.
tony: also recommend tiered ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 60% with hold windows 2h, 4h. require consensus_score to increase at each step (no downwards wiggle).
leah: implement smoothing: rolling median for p95 over 10m and EWMA for hallucination with alpha=0.2. ensure decision logs surface which metric caused a block.
arya: draft pseudo-config: ```
policy:
  name: composite-cost-latency-gate
  metrics:
    mrr: {normalize: rank, weight: 0.6}
    p95_ms: {normalize: minmax, weight: 0.25}
    cost_per_tok: {normalize: log, weight: 0.15}
  thresholds:
    consensus_score: 0.015
    deadband: 0.005
  staged_ramp:
    - traffic: 5%  hold: 2h  require_increase: true
    - traffic: 25% hold: 4h  require_increase: true
    - traffic: 60% hold: 6h
  rollback_triggers:
    - name: hallucination_spike  condition: halluc_ratio > 1.5 duration: 10m
    - name: cost_exceed       condition: cost_ratio > 1.2 duration: 15m
  smoothing:
    p95: median_window: 10m
    halluc: ewma_alpha: 0.2
```
rollout-bot: created RW-ROLL-1299 for config PR + infra hooks -> https://redwood.internal/rolls/RW-ROLL-1299
owen: I'll prototype the normalization code and a small sim that replays the AB trace to tune weights. tagging @tony for the sim validation.
leah: i'll write the auto-rollback unit tests and add alerting so SRE gets paged if an auto-rollback fires.
arya: thanks all. aim to ship the config next week, will include the sim results in the PR. :rocket:
